source_control.primary: Official NaTIS Vehicle Controls learner material and K53 public manuals
source_control.note: This pack completes identification and theory-level control/application knowledge without teaching practical riding or driving manoeuvres.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: seat

en.title: Motorcycle seat
en.key_point: The seat is the part of the motorcycle designed to support the rider.
en.explanation: Recognising the main motorcycle components is part of the learner control/component study material.

af.title: Motorfietssitplek
af.key_point: Die sitplek is die deel van die motorfiets wat ontwerp is om die ryer te ondersteun.
af.explanation: Die herkenning van die belangrikste motorfietskomponente vorm deel van die leerdermateriaal oor kontroles en komponente.

xh.title: Isihlalo sesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Isihlalo yinxalenye yesithuthuthu eyenzelwe ukuxhasa umkhweli.
xh.explanation: Ukukwazi ukuqaphela amacandelo aphambili esithuthuthu yinxalenye yezinto zokufunda zomfundi malunga nolawulo namacandelo.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: engine

en.title: Motorcycle engine
en.key_point: The engine supplies power to the motorcycle.
en.explanation: Learners should be able to identify the engine as one of the main motorcycle components.

af.title: Motorfietsenjin
af.key_point: Die enjin verskaf krag aan die motorfiets.
af.explanation: Leerders moet die enjin as een van die belangrikste motorfietskomponente kan herken.

xh.title: Injini yesithuthuthu
xh.explanation: Abafundi kufuneka bakwazi ukuqaphela injini njengenye yamacandelo aphambili esithuthuthu.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: speedometer

en.title: Motorcycle speedometer
en.key_point: The speedometer shows the motorcycle's road speed.
en.explanation: It helps the rider monitor speed and remain within the applicable limit.

af.title: Motorfietsspoedmeter
af.key_point: Die spoedmeter wys die motorfiets se padsnelheid.
af.explanation: Dit help die ryer om spoed dop te hou en binne die toepaslike spoedgrens te bly.

xh.title: Isilinganisi-santya sesithuthuthu
xh.explanation: Sinceda umkhweli alandele isantya aze ahlale ngaphakathi komda wesantya osebenzayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: ignition

en.title: Motorcycle ignition
en.key_point: The ignition control switches the motorcycle's electrical/engine system on or off.
en.explanation: Learners should recognise the ignition as a named motorcycle control/component.

af.title: Motorfietsontsteking
af.key_point: Die ontstekingsbeheer skakel die motorfiets se elektriese/enjinstelsel aan of af.
af.explanation: Leerders moet die ontsteking as 'n benoemde motorfietsbeheer of komponent kan herken.

xh.title: Isitshixo sokuvula isithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Ulawulo lokuvula lucima okanye luvule inkqubo yombane/yenjini yesithuthuthu.
xh.explanation: Abafundi kufuneka bakwazi ukuqaphela olu lawulo njengenye yezixhobo zesithuthuthu.

source.locator: NaTIS/K53 motorcycle public material — starter button

en.title: Starter button
en.key_point: The starter button is the control used to start the engine when the motorcycle is designed with an electric starter.
en.explanation: The official public K53 motorcycle material identifies the starter button among the controls near the right handgrip.

af.title: Aansitknoppie
af.key_point: Die aansitknoppie word gebruik om die enjin te begin wanneer die motorfiets 'n elektriese aansitter het.
af.explanation: Die openbare K53-motorfietsmateriaal identifiseer die aansitknoppie onder die kontroles naby die regterhandgreep.

xh.title: Iqhosha lokuqalisa
xh.key_point: Iqhosha lokuqalisa lisetyenziswa ukuqalisa injini xa isithuthuthu sinesiqalisi sombane.
xh.explanation: Izinto zoluntu ze-K53 zesithuthuthu zilibala iqhosha lokuqalisa phakathi kolawulo olukufutshane nesiphatho sasekunene.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: wheels

en.title: Motorcycle wheels
en.key_point: The front and rear wheels support the motorcycle and provide road contact through the tyres.
en.explanation: Learners should recognise the wheels and tyres as major visual components.

af.title: Motorfietswiele
af.key_point: Die voor- en agterwiele ondersteun die motorfiets en maak deur die bande kontak met die pad.
af.explanation: Leerders moet die wiele en bande as belangrike visuele komponente kan herken.

xh.title: Amavili esithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Ivili langaphambili nelangasemva lixhasa isithuthuthu kwaye amatayara adibana nendlela.
xh.explanation: Abafundi kufuneka bakwazi ukuqaphela amavili namatayara njengamacandelo abalulekileyo abonakalayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: silencer

en.title: Motorcycle silencer
en.key_point: The silencer forms part of the exhaust system and reduces exhaust noise.
en.explanation: It is a named motorcycle component in the official learner material.

af.title: Motorfietsdemper
af.key_point: Die demper vorm deel van die uitlaatstelsel en verminder uitlaatgeraas.
af.explanation: Dit is 'n benoemde motorfietskomponent in die amptelike leerdermateriaal.

xh.title: Isinciphisi-ngxolo sesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Isinciphisi-ngxolo siyinxalenye yenkqubo yokukhupha umsi kwaye sinciphisa ingxolo.
xh.explanation: Sibizwa njengelinye lamacandelo esithuthuthu kwizinto ezisemthethweni zomfundi.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: headlamp

en.title: Motorcycle headlamp
en.key_point: The headlamp is the forward-facing lamp that helps the motorcycle be seen and illuminates the road.
en.explanation: The learner must recognise the headlamp as a major motorcycle component.

af.title: Motorfietskoplig
af.key_point: Die koplig is die vorentoe-gerigte lig wat help dat die motorfiets gesien word en die pad verlig.
af.explanation: Die leerder moet die koplig as 'n belangrike motorfietskomponent kan herken.

xh.title: Isibane sangaphambili sesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Isibane sangaphambili sijonge phambili, sinceda ukuba isithuthuthu sibonakale kwaye sikhanyise indlela.
xh.explanation: Umfundi kufuneka akwazi ukusichonga njengenye yezona nxalenye zibalulekileyo zesithuthuthu.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle visual components: shock absorber

en.title: Shock absorber
en.key_point: The shock absorber is part of the motorcycle suspension system.
en.explanation: It helps control movement of the motorcycle over uneven road surfaces.

af.title: Skokbreker
af.key_point: Die skokbreker vorm deel van die motorfiets se veringstelsel.
af.explanation: Dit help om die motorfiets se beweging oor ongelyke padoppervlakke te beheer.

xh.title: Isinciphisi sokungcangcazela
xh.key_point: Isinciphisi sokungcangcazela siyinxalenye yenkqubo yokuxhoma yesithuthuthu.
xh.explanation: Sinceda ukulawula ukuhamba kwesithuthuthu kwiindlela ezingalinganiyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — motorcycle control/function sample material

en.title: Motorcycle control groups
en.key_point: Different road actions require the rider to recognise and coordinate the correct controls, such as throttle, brakes, clutch, gear lever, steering and indicators.
en.explanation: The learner-theory goal is to know which controls are associated with slowing/stopping, changing gear, steering and signalling. Practical use belongs in supervised rider training.

af.title: Motorfietsbeheergroepe
af.key_point: Verskillende padhandelinge vereis dat die ryer die regte kontroles herken en koördineer, soos versneller, remme, koppelaar, rathefboom, stuur en rigtingwysers.
af.explanation: Die teoretiese leerdoel is om te weet watter kontroles met stadiger ry/stop, ratwisseling, stuur en aandui verband hou. Praktiese gebruik hoort by toesig-ryopleiding.

xh.title: Amaqela olawulo esithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Izenzo ezahlukeneyo endleleni zifuna umkhweli aqaphele aze adibanise ulawulo oluchanekileyo, njenge-throttle, iziqhoboshi, clutch, gear lever, steering kunye nezalathisi.
xh.explanation: Injongo yethiyori kukwazi ukuba loluphi ulawulo olusetyenziswa ekucothiseni/ekumeni, ekutshintsheni iigiya, ekuqhubeni nasekuboniseni. Ukusetyenziswa ngokwenene kufuneka kufundiswe phantsi kweliso.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — rear-view mirrors and control/function sample material

en.title: Mirror awareness
en.key_point: Rear-view mirrors help the driver know what traffic is behind and alongside the vehicle before a road action.
en.explanation: The learner should recognise the centre and side mirrors and understand their observation purpose.

af.title: Spieëlbewustheid
af.key_point: Truspieëls help die bestuurder om verkeer agter en langs die voertuig te ken voordat 'n padhandeling uitgevoer word.
af.explanation: Die leerder moet die middel- en syspieëls kan herken en hul waarnemingsdoel verstaan.

xh.title: Ukuqaphela ngezibuko
xh.key_point: Izibuko zokujonga emva zinceda umqhubi azi ngezithuthi ezisemva nasecaleni phambi kokwenza intshukumo endleleni.
xh.explanation: Umfundi kufuneka akwazi ukuqaphela izibuko eziphakathi nezasemacaleni aze aqonde injongo yazo yokujonga.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — light vehicle control/function sample material

en.title: Light-vehicle control groups
en.key_point: Learners should know which controls are associated with steering, slowing/stopping, changing gear, signalling and securing a parked vehicle.
en.explanation: This is theory-level identification. Practical operation belongs in supervised driver training.

af.title: Ligte voertuig se beheergroepe
af.key_point: Leerders moet weet watter kontroles met stuur, stadiger ry/stop, ratwisseling, aandui en die beveiliging van 'n geparkeerde voertuig verband hou.
af.explanation: Dit is teoretiese identifikasie. Praktiese bediening hoort by toesig-bestuuropleiding.

xh.title: Amaqela olawulo emoto elula
xh.key_point: Abafundi kufuneka bazi ukuba loluphi ulawulo olusetyenziswa ekuqhubeni, ekucothiseni/ekumeni, ekutshintsheni iigiya, ekuboniseni nasekukhuseleni imoto xa ipakiwe.
xh.explanation: Le yinxalenye yethiyori. Ukusebenzisa ulawulo ngokwenene kufuneka kufundiswe phantsi kweliso.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — manual versus automatic vehicle note

en.title: Manual and automatic controls
en.key_point: A manual vehicle normally has clutch, brake and accelerator pedals. An automatic vehicle does not have a clutch pedal.
en.explanation: The gear selector also differs between manual and automatic vehicles.

af.title: Handrat- en outomatiese kontroles
af.key_point: 'n Handratvoertuig het gewoonlik koppelaar-, rem- en versnellerpedale. 'n Outomatiese voertuig het nie 'n koppelaarpedaal nie.
af.explanation: Die ratkeurder verskil ook tussen handrat- en outomatiese voertuie.

xh.title: Ulawulo lwemoto ye-manual ne-automatic
xh.key_point: Imoto ye-manual idla ngokuba ne-clutch, brake ne-accelerator pedals. Imoto ye-automatic ayinayo i-clutch pedal.
xh.explanation: Isikhethi segiya naso siyahluka phakathi kweemoto ze-manual neze-automatic.

source.locator: NaTIS Vehicle Controls — parking brake may be hand- or foot-operated

en.title: Parking brake variations
en.key_point: The parking brake may be hand-operated or, on some vehicles, foot-operated.
en.explanation: Its purpose is to help keep the vehicle stationary after parking.

af.title: Parkeerrem-variasies
af.key_point: Die parkeerrem kan met die hand of, op sommige voertuie, met die voet bedien word.
af.explanation: Die doel daarvan is om die voertuig stil te help hou nadat dit geparkeer is.

xh.title: Iintlobo zesibambi sokupaka
xh.key_point: Isibambi sokupaka sinokusebenza ngesandla okanye, kwezinye iimoto, ngonyawo.
xh.explanation: Injongo yaso kukunceda ukugcina imoto ime emva kokuba ipakiwe.
